review.decision: Make initial archive catalogue publication atomic and exclusive.
review.notes: An isolated child exits before or just after the real rename, before the parent can run cleanup. Parent reopens through a fresh private queue process, checks preserved native/raw replay evidence and continued stable-ID admission. Probe an existing destination so that first publication cannot replace it.

cases.description: Interrupted first catalogue publication never leaves an ambiguous linked record or blocks healthy stable IDs.
cases.setup: A private input queue contains a settled stable ID and a distinct in-flight claim. Hooks bracket the real exclusive kernel rename.
cases.action: Exit the child after file sync but before rename, or after rename before directory sync, then reopen and continue with the normal publication path. Also place a destination just before exclusive rename.
cases.expected: A stale temporary name can be recovered under the lease. The published record is a single-link file; earlier evidence still protects both native and raw routing. A verified new stable ID can publish and settle. A competing destination is preserved.
